scope_boundaries: Compact connected Riemann surface, fixed positive area-one reference form for L1 and capacity; smooth real backgrounds may change sign.
Nonemptiness is equivalent to nonnegative total area. At area zero the normalized potential is unique and smooth.
All nonnegative-area ordinary model spaces are identified with their positive polar measures; zero area gives the one-point space.
Positive-area homotheties, gauge bounds and uniform representative continuity extend to smooth real backgrounds of positive area. Capacity is always measured with a fixed positive reference form.

Uniform convergence of smooth backgrounds to a smooth zero-area background gives uniform L1 and capacity collapse of all normalized potentials and total-variation collapse of their full curvature measures.
Unscaled model diameters tend to zero with the area; area-normalized metrics are used only at positive area and retain the polar data.
Higher-dimensional zero-volume/background degeneration and infinite-mass topology remain outside this unit.
